sloka: ततो ऽर्जुनेन क्रुद्धेन सर्वप्राणेन सा गदा ।स्तनयोरन्तरे मुक्ता रावणस्य महोरसि ।। ७.३२.६० ॥
transliteration: tato 'rjunena kruddhena sarvaprāṇena sā gadā ।stanayorantare muktā rāvaṇasya mahorasi ।। 7.32.60 ॥

translations.english: Then, the enraged Arjuna, with all his might, hurled that mace at Ravana's broad chest, between his breasts.
